zh.title: 美軍AFRICOM資助Merlin 於摩洛哥測試Cessna Caravan無人傷患後送
zh.summary: Merlin獲美軍合約；於摩洛哥測試Cessna 208B無人後送
body: 總部位於波士頓的Merlin於2026年11月11日宣佈，已獲得美國非洲司令部（AFRICOM）價值50萬美元的合約，將在摩洛哥使用賽斯納208B大篷車（Cessna 208B Grand Caravan）演示無人傷患後送（CASEVAC）任務。該項目為AFRICOM自主傷患後送產業技術挑戰賽的初始階段，示範預計於美國政府2027財政年度初期展開。
演示任務將涵蓋任務接收、航線規劃、自主起飛、飛往簡陋傷患收集點，並在模擬載入傷患後完成自主返航與降落。Merlin表示，旗下Merlin Pilot軟體旨在無需地面控制站或飛行員的情況下管理導航與緊急應變。

en.title: US AFRICOM Awards Merlin $500K Contract for Autonomous CASEVAC Test in Morocco
en.summary: US AFRICOM contracts Merlin to demonstrate autonomous casualty evacuation with a Cessna Caravan in Morocco.
body: Boston-based Merlin announced on November 11, 2026, that it received a $500,000 contract from US Africa Command (AFRICOM) to demonstrate an autonomous casualty evacuation (CASEVAC) mission in Morocco using a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan. The award covers the initial phase of AFRICOM’s Autonomous CASEVAC Industry Technology Challenge, with the flight demonstration planned for early US government fiscal year 2027.

The demonstration will encompass tasking, flight planning, autonomous departure, flight to an austere casualty collection site, simulated patient loading, and autonomous return flight and landing. Merlin stated that its Merlin Pilot system manages navigation and contingency response without relying on a remote ground station or flight crew.
